# Xaml.Behaviors port tracking

Generated from Xaml.Behaviors commit `45387e325362a7351eb4ec579b55571258edc2c2` (reference `behaviors` of `scripts/port-status/references.toml`). The plan of this port: [behaviors.md](../../behaviors.md); the tracking of the framework itself: [TRACKING.md](../../TRACKING.md).

Counted: the public API, public and protected types and members (with explicit interface implementations). Internal types (upstream's operator classes and their sinks, the internal helpers) are implementation; they count only through their files, which are ported one to one. Overloads are found by name: every overload of a method counts as present once the Rust function of its name in snake case exists, or that name with a suffix (`_on` for a scheduler argument, `_with`, `_with_index`, ...) or the `try_` prefix. A missing file whose types are all waived counts as a waived file.

## Waived

Types and members waived with a reason (`docs/porting/data/behaviors/member-waivers.toml`, and the files `docs/porting/data/behaviors/path-overrides.toml` replaces): the count of types and members per reason.

| Types and members | Reason |
|---:|---|
| 18 | SourceGenerators is compile-time C# tooling (a Roslyn incremental generator); typed actions and triggers are written directly in Rust |
| 9 | Interactions.Scripting runs C# source with Roslyn scripting; there is no C# run time in a Rust application |
| 7 | Interactions.DragAndDrop.DataGrid reorders the rows of a DataGrid; FerroUI has no DataGrid (only the TreeDataGrid) |

## How to regenerate

```sh
scripts/port-status/run.sh --reference behaviors            # the checkout at /Volumes/1TB-macOS/behaviors-ref, or $BEHAVIORS_UPSTREAM
scripts/port-status/run.sh --reference behaviors --check    # exit 1 when a document is out of date; writes nothing
python3 scripts/port-status/test_gaps.py --reference behaviors --all   # the test reports, before run.sh
python3 scripts/port-status/port_status.py --reference behaviors --explain <Project> <File.cs>
```

Inputs: the project list `scripts/api-extract/projects-behaviors.json`, the extraction `docs/porting/data/behaviors/upstream-api.json`, `docs/porting/data/behaviors/path-overrides.toml`, `docs/porting/data/behaviors/member-waivers.toml` and `docs/porting/data/behaviors/test-aliases.toml`. Outputs: this directory (`docs/porting/tracking/behaviors/`) and `docs/porting/data/behaviors/port-status.json`.
